opening.argument: The presentation ties purchasing OneCoin packages to tokens that are used to mine OneCoins automatically, while claiming those tokens can produce 10-12% interest. It further links participation to fourfold investment value, projected price growth, and token interest, presenting unusually favorable benefits from a purchase. The solicitation also depends on recruitment: it calls for bringing in more people and advertises direct sales, fast start, and matching bonuses, including a 10% reward when a group reaches a €5,500 balance within 30 days. These purchase-linked returns and recruitment incentives establish a financial solicitation, although some comparisons, attributed statements, and figures remain unverified and one chart identifies its values as projections.
